s.n: Footy final party pies with tomato sauce
s.note: Beef and black pepper pies, proper tomato sauce.
s.how: Brown the onion and mince in the oil, breaking it up as it goes. Stir in the flour, then the stock, tomato paste, Worcestershire and pepper, and simmer until thick. Cool the filling, then line a greased 12-hole muffin tin with rounds of shortcrust. Fill, top with rounds of puff, press the edges and brush with egg. Bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden, then serve hot with tomato sauce.

s.note: Asparagus, lemon butter, soft white bread. Gertrude's dress for the footballers dance.
s.how: Blanch the asparagus in salted boiling water for 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water and pat dry. Beat the butter with the lemon zest, chives and pepper. Cut the crusts off the bread and roll each slice thin with a rolling pin. Spread with the butter, lay a spear across each slice, roll up tightly and cut in half.

s.n: Pratt's counter sausage rolls with tomato chutney
s.note: Pork and fennel, flaky pastry, tomato chutney.
s.how: Mix the pork, onion, carrot, breadcrumbs, fennel and a good pinch of salt. Halve the pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, seam underneath. Brush with egg, scatter with sesame and cut into short lengths. Bake at 210C until puffed and golden, then serve with the chutney.

m.n: Sergeant Farrat's chicken a la king vol-au-vents
m.note: Creamy chicken, mushrooms and tarragon in puff cases. Farrat takes a feather boa as a bribe.
m.how: Brown the chicken in the butter, then lift it out. Cook the mushrooms and capsicum in the same pan until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until it coats a spoon. Return the chicken with the peas and tarragon and simmer until cooked through. Warm the cases at 180C for 5 minutes, fill generously and serve.

m.n: Wedding breakfast roast lamb with mint sauce
m.note: Garlic and rosemary leg, crisp spuds, fresh mint sauce. Gertrude marries William Beaumont.
m.how: Stir the sugar into the boiling water, add the vinegar and mint and set the mint sauce aside. Cut small slits in the lamb, push in the garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and season well. Roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes for pink, adding the potatoes and pumpkin for the last hour. Rest the lamb for 20 minutes while the potatoes crisp up at 220C. Carve and serve with the vegetables and mint sauce.

w.n: Molly's chocolate slice with vanilla cream
w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate slice with whipped vanilla cream, for Irma's arthritis.
w.how: Melt the chocolate and butter together over low heat, then cool a little. Whisk in the sugar, eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt. Pour into a lined 20cm tin and bake at 170C until just set, with a fudgy middle. Whip the cream with the vanilla and icing sugar and serve on the cooled brownies.

d.n: Paris via Melbourne raspberry champagne cocktail
d.note: Raspberry syrup, a sugar cube, cold sparkling.
d.how: Simmer the raspberries, sugar and water for 5 minutes, then push through a sieve and chill. Drop a sugar cube and a spoonful of syrup into each flute. Top slowly with the cold sparkling and serve.
